x: The two miles walk resulted in a very fine win for the most improved walker of the season, Eric Hall with E,Smith 2nd and G.
Eric Hall led the field home in 15m. 19s. with E. Smith 2nd and G.Beecham 3rd. The handicap was won by Stan Vickers off 2.40. with Denis Ives 2nd and George Beecham 3rd.

Bob Newson and Dave McMullen were close behind, followed by G.Beecham, H.McGreechan and J.Coleman. At a further check three miles later, the team position was almost the same, with Belgrave 39pts to Met.W.C's 55 and Sheffield still a long way behind.
